stage_A_committed_package_candidate.why: A commit cannot embed its own hash. Stage A never claims final-head binding and PF-5 is not expected to pass against it. See PACKAGE_CANDIDATE_SCOPE.json.

stage_B_procedural_final_head_capsule.results_recorded_here: NONE — deliberately. The Stage-B capsule binds the FINAL evidence head, which does not exist while this file is being written. Recording its result here would be the recursive self-seal this design avoids.
